body:
Punch list of the M6 T3 audit (#650): RetroArch and the libretro cores, 344 paths, `reviewed-at: d606301784` (the slice's bytes equal to `next`'s `8ebaf8daad`). The audit is `docs/audits/2026_10_24-epic-m6-emulators-libretro/` on `feature/m6-emulators-libretro-650`. 34 items: 0 critical, 4 high, 9 medium, 21 low.

## Executive summary

The launch table is the build's own: the host regeneration from the tree's shell is byte-identical to the GENERIC_X64, H700 and SM8550 images, and the guest's installed set equals the tree's.

**The four High findings:**

- The default PlayStation core on four built devices is installed where the launcher does not load it (#802).
- The next base merge brings upstream's fix for that, and the new `yabadabadoo-lr`, as `build.${DISTRO}-` copies that fail on the fork's roots (#802).
- SM8550's grep has no PCRE, so Install Steam stops at its Proton step (#806).
- `aethersx2-sa`, dropped upstream for licensing, still ships on SM8550 and RK3566.

**The Medium found in the second opinion:** patch 0012 hands RetroArch's `system()` a shell line built from an achievement's title and description, on every unlock (PL-032).

**Currency:** all 14 upstream commits on the slice are `to merge`, two of them adapted. Of the 151 pins, 40 are current, 104 behind their project, 1 behind ROCKNIX and 6 not on their project's default branch. RetroArch is 7,623 commits behind master, and a bump is a re-cut of its patch series.

**Time to play** on the image as built: 0.62 s to the first frame and 1.01 s game to game (n = 3).

## Acceptance-criteria scorecard (#650, at the end of Phase 2)

4 PASS (AC-06, AC-07, AC-08, AC-12); 5 PARTIAL (AC-01, AC-05, AC-09, AC-10, AC-11); 6 open for later stages of the lane (AC-02, AC-03, AC-04, AC-13, AC-14, AC-15); 0 FAIL. `02-forward-audit.md` § Criterion entries has each with its evidence.

## The items

Each checkbox is ticked from its acceptance artifact when its Phase 7 outcome is recorded in `05-punch-list.md` (resolved with its commit, deferred to a named issue, or withdrawn with its reason).

- [x] **PL-001** (High, Q3, Interaction Defect) (#802): The default PlayStation core on H700, RK3326, RK3566 and SM8550 is not where the launcher loads it. Acceptance: An arm-enabled build's install tree (H700 or SM8550) carries usr/lib/libretro/pcsx_rearmed32_libretro.so; tools/regen-es-systems.sh's table for that device is unchanged. -- **Phase 7: Deferred** (#802: the packet `a0defbd527` (fix/m6-802-pcsx-rearmed32, upstream c9820d0e89 with DISTRONAME), reviewed and applied by M7; reaches next with the integration)
- [x] **PL-002** (High, Q4, Interaction Defect) (#802): The next base merge brings two `build.${DISTRO}-` copies the fork's roots cannot satisfy, and git merges them cleanly. Acceptance: On the merged tree, git grep -F 'build.${DISTRO}-' -- projects packages scripts prints nothing, and the five rotation-table recipes carry Python3:host, retroarch and PKG_NEED_UNPACK. -- **Phase 7: Deferred** (#802: with the packet `a0defbd527` and the base merge, which takes yabadabadoo-lr the same way)
- [x] **PL-003** (High, Q3, Interaction Defect) (#806): On the SM8550 image Install Steam stops at its Proton step: `grep -oP` with a grep built without PCRE. Acceptance: git grep -n -E 'grep (-[a-zA-Z]*P|--perl-regexp)' on Install Steam.sh prints nothing, and a guest run of fetch_proton_latest_release against a fixture release JSON, with a grep that refuses -P first on PATH, sets PROTON_GE_URL and PROTON_GE_TAR. -- **Phase 7: Deferred** (#806: the recipe packet `ea0af11d07` (fix/m6-806-grep-pcre2), reviewed and applied by M7; the script lines deferred:M7-merge with 6101242e14)
- [x] **PL-004** (High, Q4, Spec Drift): `aethersx2-sa`, dropped upstream for a licensing concern, still ships on SM8550 and RK3566. Acceptance: On the merged tree, git grep -n aethersx2 -- projects/ROCKNIX/packages/virtual/emulators prints nothing. -- **Phase 7: Deferred** (class 1: upstream `c4d353449e` with the base merge (the coordinator, #650; the maintainer told on #346))
- [x] **PL-005** (Medium, Q3, Code Quality) (#813): `melonds-ds-lr` fetches eleven dependencies from the network at configure time, by short hash or tag. Acceptance: The recipe sets FETCHCONTENT_FULLY_DISCONNECTED=ON and names each dependency with a full hash and a checksum, and a build of the core from an unseeded source cache in a container with no network configures, with find <root>/build/melonds-ds-lr-*/.*/_deps -name '*-subbuild' printing nothing. -- **Phase 7: Deferred** (#813: S1: pinned at `df69f527ad` (twelve full commits, each equal to the built clone); carrying the sources stays #813)
- [x] **PL-006** (Medium, Q3, Code Quality) (#814): `retroarch32` is skipped silently when the ARM root's install directory is not exactly one, and a single stale one is copied unchecked. Acceptance: The sandboxed makeinstall_target exits 1 with the path named for a root with no retroarch install directory and for one with two, refuses a root whose one directory carries another version, and installs retroarch32 for one with the pinned version. -- **Phase 7: Deferred** (#814: S1: fixed at `e8bfe9ddda`, its way out named at `de4faa8465` (ENABLE_32BIT=no from the environment); the fixture proves zero, two and stale die; the image proves the copy (#814))
- [x] **PL-007** (Medium, Q7, Documentation Gap): The table's README claims a build failure on two default cores; one shape fails silently and the other ships two defaults. Acceptance: package.mk's README comment states the two behaviours or the check T5's fix adds, and the regeneration's tables for the five devices are byte-unchanged. -- **Phase 7: Deferred** (routed to T5 (#652, its PL-06): the mechanism in distributions/ROCKNIX/config/functions)
- [x] **PL-008** (Medium, Q2, Code Quality): GitHub release data reaches `eval` in `fetch_proton_latest_release`. Acceptance: On the merged file, grep -n eval in fetch_proton_latest_release prints nothing. -- **Phase 7: Deferred** (deferred:M7-merge: Install Steam.sh is changed by the M7 hunk `6101242e14`; its row goes on the follow-up the merge names)
- [x] **PL-009** (Medium, Q3, Code Quality) (#815): The Steam runtime and Proton archives are installed with no integrity check. Acceptance: On the guest with a fixture release whose .sha512sum does not match its archive, install_proton_variant refuses with a named reason and installs nothing; with a matching one it installs. -- **Phase 7: Deferred** (#815: deferred:M7-merge: Install Steam.sh is changed by the M7 hunk `6101242e14`; its row goes on the follow-up the merge names)
- [x] **PL-010** (Medium, Q3, Code Quality) (#816): On SM8550 the exit hotkey's kill target for RPCS3 names a process that never runs.
